subject: A small web experiment with one changing owner
text:
Hi Martin,

I read your note about looking after the community of artists and technologists at Pervasive Media Studio, and being interested in other people’s projects. I thought this small web experiment might be up your street.

I built Take The Wall: one public page with one featured owner. Someone can put up a project or message, and it stays until the next person takes over. Would you be interested in trying it with a page or project of yours?

Browsing and previewing are free; a takeover costs $3.99. There’s no guaranteed audience or duration — it’s an early experiment rather than a promise of exposure.

https://takethewall.com/?utm_source=personal&utm_medium=outreach&utm_campaign=first_owners&utm_content=martin-oleary

No need to reply if it’s not a fit; I won’t send follow-up reminders.

Take The Wall
contact@takethewall.com
